evals.name: create-concept-note
evals.prompt: I just read a good explanation of chain-of-thought prompting - getting an LLM to reason step by step before answering. Add a note on it to my AI Research vault.
evals.expected_output: A new Title Case note (e.g. 'Chain Of Thought Prompting.md') in Research/, starting with frontmatter: created (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm from `date`), author [claude], topics as quoted wikilinks. No timestamp, Status: or Tags: body lines; adapted emoji sections and a --- + # References footer; no H1 repeating the filename. `.tools/vault lint` passes on it.

evals.name: create-note-and-index
evals.prompt: I've been digging into ReAct - the agent pattern where the model interleaves reasoning traces with tool-use actions. Capture it, and group it with my other agent notes.
evals.expected_output: A new ReAct note in Research/ in vault format whose topics link to the existing agents topic hub (e.g. [[AI Coding Agents]]) so the hub's embedded Base lists it. No hand-built 'Agents Index.md' is created. `.tools/vault lint` passes.

evals.name: find-and-link
evals.prompt: What do I already have on retrieval in my AI Research notes? Then add a note on hybrid search (combining keyword/BM25 with vector search) and link it to the relevant existing notes.
evals.expected_output: Reports the existing retrieval notes found across the vault. Creates Research/Hybrid Search.md in vault format with topics and [[wikilinks]] to the existing retrieval notes (e.g. Retrieval Augmented Generation, Vector Database). `.tools/vault lint` passes.
